item.text: I’ll refactor only the two affected test sources, centralizing the repeated `InetAddress` stubbing while preserving each test’s existing cases and assertions. Then I’ll run the focused Maven tests if the module setup permits.

The common portion is the host-address and loopback stubbing. I’m extracting that into a small package-local test utility; the interface-selection test will keep its additional reachability stub, while the address-validation test will express each input case through the shared helper.
